_note: 0.8.4 S16 (H, Muad 09 Nov 2026): the input window W, in tokens, of each OpenRouter model a shipped chain seats, for the final read's room rule (a part's whole prompt at chars/4 plus the seat's cap must fit in HALF of W). Written by scripts/refresh-context-windows.mjs. W is the SMALLEST context_length over the model's hosts (OpenRouter /api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints) and the router's own list figure; the hosts counted are the ones the price rows count, minus the page-only 'Not used in Standard routing' flag: fast, ultrafast, priority and flex tiers are left out, and so is a host whose published output limit is below the smallest maxTokens a shipped chain gives the model. A model missing from this table has no W: the final read makes no room check for it (it reads as before). The first fill of 2026-11-09 was made by an equivalent pass outside the script (no node on the author's laptop); a run of the script must reproduce it.
